description: Calgary Transit Ridership (2007 - 2025) is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. Transit ridership including system-level ridership, sub groups, and by fare product. Sub groups include adult, youth, seniors, low income, free fare zone, and internal recoveries. Fare products include single ride fares, monthly passes, daily passes, annual passes, semester passes (U-Pass), and airport passes. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. Its tags are transit, ridership, trips, boardings, riders. The table has 27 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2026-03-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
